patternA.shape: Two role=front files at different ordinals in the family folder, plus one role=capped capState=on file in '31. Capped & Uncapped'.
patternA.reading: The capped file is the unambiguous capped front the plate needs. The ambiguity is only between the two unlabelled family-folder files.

patternB.shape: One role=front file in the family folder, plus one file in '21. Tassels/Updated Tassels' classified role=component.
patternB.reading: Rendered, both files are complete bottle-plus-tassel assemblies, so the component label on the Updated Tassels file looks wrong. Worth confirming before either is chosen as the front.

conclusion: Every Slim gap is a source-classification decision, not a missing asset: 215 PSDs cover all 123 products and no blocked row lacks a PSD. Resolving the two patterns above is what unblocks the family, not new photography.
decisionSheets: 55 side-by-side renders were produced during this investigation; they are previews, not committed assets.
